verdict.rationale: Highnote documents an integrated ledger that tracks balances and money movement, posts transactions as they occur rather than in an end-of-day batch, and supports reconciliation on the same core ledger, with in-house teams handling daily reconciliation and settlement. However, the evidence never shows a ledger view that ties each authorization to its clearing record, nor any settlement report a finance lead can reconcile. Missing for 10: documented authorization-to-clearing linkage in the ledger, settlement reporting artifacts or exports, explicit card-level balance views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see money move in real time — account and card balances, a transaction ledger that ties every authorization to its clearing, and settlement reporting that reconciles to the penny

citations.quote: Track money movement and balances with the integrated ledger.
